title: Order confirmation emails not sent
alert: notification queue depth 52,000 and rising; customer rohit.m@yahoo.com got no confirmation
root cause: A deploy changed the email template id and the notifier kept failing and requeuing
fix: Rolled back the template change and drained the queue with a rate limit

title: Checkout returning 503
alert: Carts emptied for logged-in users; redis-cart evictions 40k per minute
root cause: Redis cart memory filled up and evicted live cart sessions while the autoscaler added pods that opened more connections
fix: Froze cart-service autoscaling, raised redis-cart maxmemory, switched eviction to volatile-lru and warmed the top 500 products

title: Card payments failing at checkout
alert: payment-bridge gateway returned 502 for 7% of card payments
root cause: The primary card gateway had a partial outage and the failover flag had been left off after a test
fix: Turned on automatic failover to the secondary gateway and added an alert when the flag is off

title: Product pages slow at sale launch
alert: Origin requests up 9x at 12:00 for a flash sale; product page load time 7s
root cause: A full CDN purge right before a flash sale sent all traffic to origin
fix: Stopped full purges before sales; purge changed URLs only and pre-warm the top pages

title: Product pages hanging
alert: Product pages waiting 8s on reco-service; support line 9811122233 flooded
root cause: Product pages called reco-service synchronously with no timeout
fix: Added a 300ms timeout with a circuit breaker and a static fallback list

title: Product pages slow at sale launch
alert: Origin requests up 9x at 12:00 for the festive sale; product page load time 7s
root cause: A full CDN purge right before the festive sale sent all traffic to origin
failed fixes: Adding more origin servers during the spike
fix: Stopped full purges before sales; purge changed URLs only and pre-warm the top pages

title: Checkout timeouts at peak
alert: checkout-api database pool exhausted; p99 6s during the festive sale
root cause: The connection pool was sized for normal traffic, not the festive sale
fix: Raised the pool size and added a read replica for order history queries
